changelog: Unchosen stars in the rating input are outlines in the text colour, 3:1 against light and dark pages alike.
The focus ring on the stars stays the text colour before and after a rating is chosen.
The rating radios run 1 to 5 in the page, as drawn: Tab lands on 1 and Right moves to 2 (Left on right-to-left pages); the fill uses :has().
The photo picker's own text takes the form's colour, readable on dark pages.
End-to-end checks run on a light page and a dark one, with axe and contrast measured from computed colours.
